descript.abstract:
This polygon datalayer shows the areas across the commonwealth with water and sewer service as provided by the Massachusetts Water Resources Authority. Most of the service areas are based on city and town boundaries, but some municipalities are split for different types of service.
The layer is stored in ArcSDE and distributed as MWRASERVICE_POLY.

procstep.procdesc: Using ArcGIS software, MWRA GIS staff edited a version of the Massachusetts Towns layer and coded the polygons for type of service. In cases where service differs within a town, the original Towns polygon was split and coded as necessary. MWRA made the layer available to MassGIS.
